creation.entry.keju_mingjing.zh: 科举 · 明经科（帖经、墨义，取中较易）
creation.entry.keju_mingjing.en: Examinations: Classicist track (passage completion and written explication of the classics; easier to pass)

creation.entry.keju_jinshi.zh: 科举 · 进士科（诗赋、策问，难而清贵）
creation.entry.keju_jinshi.en: Examinations: Presented Scholar track (poetry and rhapsody composition plus policy essay questions; hard but prestigious)

creation.entry.toujun.zh: 投军 · 折冲府应募，队正起步
creation.entry.toujun.en: Enlist: join an Assault-resisting Garrison, starting as Squad Leader

protagonist.mingjing.role.zh: 无名县衙小吏，以推理与人脉立身
protagonist.mingjing.role.en: A nameless county clerk who lives by deduction and connections

protagonist.mingjing.blurb.zh: 他把县狱的每一桩旧案都读成了书。上官说他眼里揉不得沙子，同僚说他迟早惹祸——直到那桩丝帛血案摆上案头。
protagonist.mingjing.blurb.en: He has read every old case in the county jail like scripture. His superiors say his eyes tolerate no grain of sand; his colleagues say he will bring trouble on himself sooner or later—until the silk-and-blood case lands on his desk.

protagonist.baishen.role.zh: 一介布衣，可科举可投军；唯一可自由分配四维
protagonist.baishen.role.en: A plain commoner; sit the examinations or enlist—the only origin with free attribute allocation

protagonist.baishen.blurb.zh: 一介布衣，无门第可倚。长安米贵，居大不易——可这满城朱紫，哪一个不是从青袍熬起？
protagonist.baishen.blurb.en: A commoner with no clan at your back. Rice is dear in Chang'an and living is hard—yet every crimson and purple robe in this city once sweated its years out in cyan.

protagonist.shuzu.role.zh: 边镇无名士兵，抗吐蕃、后突厥，军功叙迁
protagonist.shuzu.role.en: A nameless frontier soldier facing the Tibetan Empire (Tufan) and the Second Türk Khaganate, rising by battlefield merit

protagonist.shuzu.blurb.zh: 大非川的雪埋过同袍的靴子。军功簿上你的名字写了又涂，涂了又写——这一回，得让它留下来。
protagonist.shuzu.blurb.en: The snows of Dafeichuan buried your comrades' boots. Your name has been written into the merit rolls and struck out, again and again—this time it must stay.

protagonist.nvguan.role.zh: 掖庭宫人，以文才与宫廷博弈升迁，可参预机要
protagonist.nvguan.role.en: A woman of the Palace Domestic Service, rising by literary gift and court maneuvering, with a hand in confidential affairs

protagonist.nvguan.blurb.zh: 掖庭的灯火熄得最晚。你替人抄经、代人拟表，字迹清峻如刀——迟早有一日，它会落到该看见它的人眼里。
protagonist.nvguan.blurb.en: Lamps burn latest in the Palace Domestic Service. You copy sutras and draft memorials for others, in a hand clean and sharp as a knife—one day it will fall under the eyes meant to see it.

protagonist.hushang.role.zh: 西市粟特商贾，金钱起点高而无官身；可纳资或以情报换官
protagonist.hushang.role.en: A Sogdian trader of the Western Market—rich in coin, empty of rank; office may be had by contribution or by traded intelligence

protagonist.hushang.blurb.zh: 从撒马尔罕到西市，三万里驼铃。你数得清每一枚开元通宝的成色，也听得见每一句不该听见的话。
protagonist.hushang.blurb.en: From Samarkand to the Western Market, thirty thousand li of camel bells. You can grade every Kaiyuan Tongbao coin by touch—and hear every word you were never meant to hear.

status.palace_attendant.en: Attendant of the Palace Domestic Service

status.sogdian_merchant.en: Registered Sogdian merchant of the Western Market

rep.jianghu.en: Standing in the Rivers and Lakes

study.chapter_locked.zh: 第一章尚未开卷（第 4 阶段实装）
study.chapter_locked.en: Chapter One is not yet open (arrives with Stage 4)

settings.font_scale_note.zh: 中文基准字号 22 px，只增不减
settings.font_scale_note.en: Chinese base font size is 22 px and only scales up

settings.colorblind_note.zh: 好恶增减一律以 ✓/✗ 符号与颜色双编码
settings.colorblind_note.en: Approval and loss are always double-coded with ✓/✗ symbols plus color

save.error.corrupt.zh: 存档受损，已停止读取。绝不带着缺损的档继续——那比读档失败更糟。
save.error.corrupt.en: The save file is damaged, so loading was stopped. We never continue on a broken save—that is worse than failing to load.

save.error.too_new.zh: 此存档来自更新版本的游戏，请更新后再读取。
save.error.too_new.en: This save comes from a newer version of the game. Update the game to load it.

save.error.migration_missing.zh: 存档版本无法迁移。这是程序缺陷，请向我们报告。
save.error.migration_missing.en: This save version cannot be migrated. This is a bug on our side—please report it.

promotion.reason.ladder_end.zh: 已至本线极品，无可再迁
promotion.reason.ladder_end.en: Already at the summit of this track; no further promotion

promotion.reason.no_evaluation.en: No merit evaluation on record; promotion requires one

promotion.reason.special_edict.en: Rated Upper-upper: promoted by special edict

promotion.reason.term_incomplete.en: The four-year term of evaluations is not yet complete

promotion.reason.grades_low.zh: 考第不及中中，迁转无望
promotion.reason.grades_low.en: Evaluations fell below Middle-middle; promotion denied

promotion.reason.no_distinction.zh: 四考无一中上，循资难迁
promotion.reason.no_distinction.en: No evaluation reached Middle-upper in the term; seniority alone will not carry you

promotion.reason.term_complete.en: Term complete with sound evaluations: promoted in due course

npc.zheng_wu.en: Zheng Wu of the street patrol (wuhou)

activity.baking.en: kneading dough and firing the oven

activity.await_gate.en: waiting for the ward gate to open

activity.return_ward.en: hurrying back before the dusk drums

ward.curfew_on.zh: ◐ 宵禁 · 坊门已闭，武侯巡街
ward.curfew_on.en: ◐ Curfew: ward gates shut, the street patrol (wuhou) walks the lanes

ward.gates_open.en: ○ Ward gates open; the market hum drifts in

ward.rest_morning.en: Rest until the Mao hour tomorrow

ward.controls_hint.zh: 右键拖动环视 · 滚轮远近 · 方向键移步
ward.controls_hint.en: Right-drag to look · scroll to zoom · arrow keys to move

affinity.dyn.rep_high.jianghu.en: Renowned in the rivers and lakes ({0})

affinity.dyn.rep_low.jianghu.en: Slight repute in the rivers and lakes ({0})

affinity.dyn.dress_slight.en: A breach of dress decorum (cyan robe before a scarlet official)

gift.wenxuan.en: a copy of the Wen Xuan anthology

rumor.gate_repair.zh: 坊正说南门门枢吱呀作响，过两日要请匠人来修。
rumor.gate_repair.en: The ward head says the south gate hinge creaks; a craftsman is due in a day or two.

rumor.pepper_arrived.zh: 西市新到一批胡椒，价钱贵得吓人，还是有人抢着买。
rumor.pepper_arrived.en: A fresh lot of peppercorns hit the Western Market—frightfully dear, yet buyers scramble for it.

rumor.wuhou_rotation.zh: 武侯铺下月换防，郑五说不定要调去别的坊。
rumor.wuhou_rotation.en: The street patrol (wuhou) post rotates next month; Zheng Wu may be moved to another ward.

rumor.silk_case.zh: 听说县里那桩丝帛血案还没了结，商队的人都绕着城南走。
rumor.silk_case.en: They say that silk-and-blood case at the county seat is still unsolved; caravans keep clear of the south side.

rumor.well_tale.zh: 有人说三更天听见坊井里有响动，桓夫子笑说是取水的桶没系牢。
rumor.well_tale.en: Some claim to hear noises from the ward well at the third watch; Master Huan laughs it off as a loose bucket rope.

interact.away.en: They are not in the ward just now.

interact.result.greet_first.en: Names exchanged, courtesies made—you are acquainted now.

interact.result.greet.en: A few pleasant words; the mood warms.

interact.result.greet_again.en: You have already talked today; nothing more to gain.

interact.result.gift_liked.en: You present {0}; their face lights up.

interact.result.gift_wrong.zh: 奉上{0}，对方勉强收下，神色淡淡。
interact.result.gift_wrong.en: You present {0}; it is accepted with a thin, polite smile.

interact.result.gift_no_money.zh: 囊中羞涩，买不起这件礼。
interact.result.gift_no_money.en: Your purse cannot stretch to this gift.

interact.result.insult.zh: 你出言不逊，对方拂袖而去。
interact.result.insult.en: Your harsh words send them storming off.

interact.result.insult_proud.zh: 你出言不逊。此人目光一沉——这笔账，记下了。
interact.result.insult_proud.en: Your harsh words land. Their eyes darken—this will be remembered.

interact.result.spar_win.zh: 点到即止，你略胜半招，围观者暗暗称好。
interact.result.spar_win.en: A friendly bout, and you edge it by half a move; onlookers murmur approval.

interact.result.spar_lose.zh: 你落了下风，对方抱拳笑道：承让。
interact.result.spar_lose.en: You come off worse; your opponent cups their fists with a smile: well fought.

interact.result.spar_refused.zh: 对方摆手笑辞：老朽这把骨头，可经不起折腾。
interact.result.spar_refused.en: They wave you off with a laugh: these old bones are past such games.

interact.result.steal_ok.zh: 你的手快过眼，摸走了 {0} 文。
interact.result.steal_ok.en: Quicker than the eye—you lift {0} wen.

interact.result.steal_seen.zh: 钱到手了，可有人看见了你的手。
interact.result.steal_seen.en: The coins are yours—but someone saw your hand.

interact.result.ask_brushoff.zh: 对方左右而言他，显然不愿多讲。
interact.result.ask_brushoff.en: They talk around the question, plainly unwilling to say more.

dlg.huan.greet.zh: 贤契来了。老朽方才校到一处讹字，正自烦恼。
dlg.huan.greet.en: Ah, you. This old man just tripped over a corrupt character in the text—most vexing.

dlg.huan.c_news.zh: 请教夫子，坊中近来可有新鲜事？
dlg.huan.c_news.en: Master, any news about the ward of late?

dlg.huan.c_ask_book.en: What book are you collating, Master?

dlg.huan.c_borrow.zh: 学生斗胆，想借夫子的《文选》一观。
dlg.huan.c_borrow.en: If I may be so bold—might I borrow your Wen Xuan?

dlg.huan.book.zh: 《汉书》。班孟坚下笔如铸，可惜传抄的人手滑。
dlg.huan.book.en: The Book of Han. Ban Gu wrote as if casting bronze—pity the copyists' hands slip.

dlg.huan.c_case_probe.zh: 夫子博闻——可听说过县里的丝帛案？
dlg.huan.c_case_probe.en: You hear everything, Master—what of that silk case at the county seat?

dlg.huan.news.zh: 新鲜事么……南门的门枢该修了，井绳换了新的。旁的，茶余饭后自有人讲。
dlg.huan.news.en: News? The south gate hinge wants mending, and the well got a new rope. The rest gets told over tea.

dlg.huan.c_case_ask.zh: 听闻县里出了桩丝帛血案？
dlg.huan.c_case_ask.en: They say there was a silk-and-blood case at the county seat?

dlg.huan.c_case_more.zh: 丝帛案的事，夫子可还有指教？
dlg.huan.c_case_more.en: About that silk case—anything more you might teach me?

dlg.huan.case.zh: 唔——商队在城南折了货，人也没了。官府封了卷宗，坊间只当谈资。你是吏门中人：少打听，多读书。
dlg.huan.case.en: Hm. A caravan lost its goods south of the walls—and a man besides. The yamen sealed the file; the ward treats it as table talk. You serve in an office: read more, pry less.

dlg.huan.c_case_press.zh: 夫子既知内情，何不细说？
dlg.huan.c_case_press.en: You clearly know more, Master—why not say it plainly?

dlg.huan.case2.zh: ……卷宗封在县廨西阁。老朽只说到这里，贤契好自为之。
dlg.huan.case2.en: …The file sits sealed in the west chamber of the county office. That is all this old man will say—mind your steps.

dlg.huan.lend.zh: 书要爱惜。三日后还我，缺一页都不行。
dlg.huan.lend.en: Treat it kindly. Three days, and not a page missing.

case.silk.brief.zh: 商队于城南折货折人，卷宗封存县廨西阁。上官限期十日。
case.silk.brief.en: A caravan lost its goods and a man south of the walls; the file sits sealed in the county office's west chamber. Ten days, by order.

case.silk.clue.dossier.zh: 卷宗摘录：报损上等绢三百匹，尸格载伤在后颈。
case.silk.clue.dossier.en: Dossier extract: three hundred bolts of fine silk reported lost; the coroner notes a wound to the nape.

case.silk.clue.dossier.hint.zh: 县廨西阁的封存卷宗（桓夫子言语间提过）。
case.silk.clue.dossier.hint.en: The sealed file in the county office's west chamber (Master Huan let it slip).

case.silk.clue.permit.zh: 商队路引：申时三刻出城。
case.silk.clue.permit.en: Caravan travel permit: left the city at the third quarter of the Shen hour.

case.silk.clue.permit.hint.zh: 西市打听商队旧事（康三识得那队人）。
case.silk.clue.permit.hint.en: Ask around the Western Market (Kang San knew that caravan).

case.silk.clue.patrol_log.zh: 武侯巡夜记录：戌时方见车队过南门。
case.silk.clue.patrol_log.en: Street-patrol (wuhou) night log: the carts passed the south gate only at the Xu hour.

case.silk.clue.patrol_log.hint.zh: 武侯铺的巡夜簿（郑五当值时执笔）。
case.silk.clue.patrol_log.hint.en: The night log at the street-patrol (wuhou) post (Zheng Wu keeps it).

case.silk.clue.torn_silk.zh: 撕裂的绢帛：上等绢里掺着次绢。
case.silk.clue.torn_silk.en: A torn bolt: coarse silk hidden among the fine.

case.silk.clue.torn_silk.hint.zh: 城南出事地界拾得的残货。
case.silk.clue.torn_silk.hint.en: Salvage picked up at the scene south of the walls.

case.silk.inf.time_gap.zh: 推论：出城与过门差了两个时辰——车队中途停过，有人做了手脚。
case.silk.inf.time_gap.en: Inference: two hours between leaving the city and passing the gate—the carts stopped, and someone was busy.

case.silk.inf.ledger_gap.zh: 推论：账载上等绢，实货掺次——亏空在先，灭口在后。
case.silk.inf.ledger_gap.en: Inference: the ledger says fine silk, the goods say otherwise—the shortfall came first, the killing after.

case.outcome.expired.zh: 逾期未结，上官收回案卷。
case.outcome.expired.en: The deadline passed; the file was recalled.

case.outcome.forced_right.zh: 严刑之下，账房招认。案速破，坊间却有怨言。
case.outcome.forced_right.en: Under the rod, the bookkeeper confessed. Swift—but the ward mutters.

case.outcome.forced_wrong.zh: 屈打成招，「凶手」画押。上官记功，街巷侧目。
case.outcome.forced_wrong.en: A confession beaten out, a scapegoat marked. Credit at the yamen; cold eyes in the lanes.

case.outcome.thorough_right.zh: 人证物证俱全，账房伏法。民间称快。
case.outcome.thorough_right.en: Testimony and evidence aligned; the bookkeeper faced the law. The ward applauds.

case.outcome.thorough_wrong.zh: 证据虽全，所指非人。清誉受损。
case.outcome.thorough_wrong.en: Evidence in hand, the wrong man named. Your good name suffers.

case.days_left.zh: 限期尚余 {0} 日。时不我待——坊中诸事仍在各自发生。
case.days_left.en: {0} days remain. Time runs on—life in the ward does not wait.

case.fetch.need_hint.zh: 还不知卷宗封在何处——坊中长者或许听过风声。
case.fetch.need_hint.en: You do not yet know where the file is sealed—an elder in the ward may have heard.

case.fetch.need_kang.zh: 康三与你交情未到（需好感 40），不肯翻旧事。
case.fetch.need_kang.en: Kang San does not know you well enough (regard 40 needed) to dig up old matters.

case.fetch.need_zheng.zh: 郑五公事公办（需好感 45），巡夜簿不给外人看。
case.fetch.need_zheng.en: Zheng Wu is all business (regard 45 needed); the log is not for outsiders.

case.fetch.need_dossier.zh: 先得知道案发地界——卷宗里写着。
case.fetch.need_dossier.en: First learn where it happened—the dossier says.

case.combine_hint.zh: 点选两条线索试着并起来看。
case.combine_hint.en: Pick two clues and lay them side by side.

case.combine_nothing.zh: 这两条并在一起，看不出什么。
case.combine_nothing.en: Laid together, these two say nothing new.

case.witness_no.zh: 关键证人{0}不肯开口（智慧或好感须达标）。
case.witness_no.en: The key witness, {0}, will not talk (wisdom or regard must qualify).

case.evidence_count.zh: 在手证据 {0} / 详审所需 {1}
case.evidence_count.en: Evidence in hand {0} / needed for a thorough case {1}

case.accuse_not_ready.zh: 详审未备：证据或证人不足。
case.accuse_not_ready.en: Not ready for due process: evidence or witness lacking.

case.method_note.zh: 严刑速破：快，官声升而民望跌，且可能抓错人。缓查详审：慢，误了别的事，但民望升、真相更准。
case.method_note.en: The rod is swift: standing at court rises, the people's regard falls, and the wrong neck may pay. Due process is slow—other matters may suffer—but the people approve and the truth holds.
